clusters.theme: The Cambodia scam case reaches a US court
APT28, APT41 and the week's threat map
KEV week, continued: two more flaws, actively exploited
Stablecoins get a fraud layer; scams keep scaling
A governance heist and a wallet breach
Funding week and the IPO chill
Supply-chain root causes, from LiteLLM to Brotli
India's security Sunday and a fintech AI bet
The leak that poisoned the pipeline
Eight million tips, seven months late
The fee bump that signed the theft
PHP2Shell's third week: exploited, attributed, and now scanned
Node2Shell: one Brotli flaw, patches everywhere
AI's money squeeze: debt, price cuts, and a bank's AI buy

items.author: Emma Roth
items.headline: Apple is rolling out a new “Made for iPhone Duo” badge in the App Store, and touts Netflix, Prime Video, Zoom, Word, and Outlook as Duo-optimized apps at launch
Developers bring new app experiences to iPhone Duo — the official partner announcement behind the Duo badge
Sources: the Pentagon quietly establishes the Technology Support Office (TSO), an agency to execute covert sabotage, cyberattacks, and supply chain disruptions

items.author: Elias Schisgall
items.headline: 1Password passes $500M in ARR, up from $400M in November 2025, driven by enterprise AI coding assistants and agents, and announces 1Password for Agents
Ukraine says the abrupt throttling of US-funded Starshield grounded dozens of drones mid-flight, costing one unit $1M+, and halted some strikes for three days

items.author: John Reynolds
items.headline: Enact, which develops full-stack tech for general-purpose robots, emerges from stealth with a $30M pre-seed from Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch, Yann LeCun, and more
1Password for Agents lets personal AI agents log in without ever seeing the password — approval-based sign-in for agents from Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, and others at launch
Bybit Fintech FZE secures a VASP licence from Dubai's VARA for spot-trading exchange services, with derivatives to follow — announced via PR Newswire from its Dubai headquarters

New global Top Fraud Trends Report: 81% of suspected digital fraud in H1 2026 struck existing customer relationships, with fraud losses near 7% of annual revenue — and nearly 1 in 5 outbound US business-to-consumer calls was spoofed

items.author: Lori Comstock
items.headline: NSA and CISA urge immediate patching for the PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619) as Wikipedia takes supporting services offline, 4chan goes read-only, and European government sites go dark for emergency fixes; Automattic says WordPress.com and Tumblr are protected

DeepSeek raises ~$15B at a ~$74B pre-money valuation — one of China's biggest funding rounds ever, led by CATL and Tencent — two days after US federal civilian agencies were ordered to strip out DeepSeek's AI technology
Ultra Security emerges from stealth with $10M in seed capital to build security tooling for autonomous AI agents — betting firms can keep their defences ahead of the agents
London Stock Exchange Group strikes a $3.535B all-cash agreement to buy Octus, the New York-based credit intelligence, data and workflow specialist

Axios reports major US banks — Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, JPMorgan, Wells Fargo and Citi — are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents inside customer accounts and moving to restrict access, with some agents acting beyond user instructions (Reuters notes it could not immediately verify the report)

CISA, FBI, US Secret Service and international law enforcement warn SafePay ransomware has breached 600+ critical infrastructure organizations since August 2024 — one of the most active operations of 2026

NSA and Britain's NCSC join the PHP2Shell alarm as emergency patching takes Wikimedia services and parts of the BBC offline; Wordfence warns updating WordPress alone won't fix it — the PHP runtime itself must be patched

Overnight roundup: LiteLLM's release pipeline hacked to push credential-stealing malware; OpenCode silently patches a critical RCE without an advisory; GoDaddy revokes 404,607 TLS certificates; 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to siphon traffic

CoinDCX denies a fresh $16M hack after on-chain investigators flag ~15.99M USDT and 5,784 TRX moving from CoinDCX-linked wallets; co-founder Sumit Gupta blames old wallets from the July 2025 breach, while ZachXBT says one deposit address stayed active until May 2026
New Android banking Trojan 'Hirudo' deletes victims' genuine banking apps and installs tampered copies with the same name and version to slip past security checks

Amazon says the AI-found PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619) are "now being broadly exploited in the wild" — its decoy servers saw first attempts on October 17, four days before PHP shipped patches, and VirusTotal counts more than 5.1 million exposed PHP hosts (reported via BleepingComputer)

Anthropic cybersecurity chief Jason Clinton warns software vulnerabilities "will get worse before improving," telling organizations to "hold on for 18 months" — after which cheaper AI models should let developers stop shipping security bugs

eMudhra, an Indian certificate authority, will exit its global SSL/TLS certificate business after eight intermediate CA keys were found easily guessable — the board decided five days after the disclosure
Multiple waves of DDoS attacks disrupted North Korea's internet infrastructure this week, intermittently knocking more than 40 official websites offline for about 32 hours

items.author: Renil S Varghese
items.headline: CoinDCX confirms an operational failure behind the ~$16M in flagged wallets: users kept depositing into deprecated wallets from its July 2025 breach while the sweep process failed — affected users were credited and the company absorbed the loss

OpenAI is nearing a $30B raise at a $1.25T pre-money valuation led by Coatue and UAE investors — a record for the most valuable private company ever, framed as an "opportunistic" bridge to a planned IPO (CNBC reporting)

A New Mexico judge orders Meta to pay $25B after a jury found the company misled consumers in the Cambridge Analytica case — 43M+ consumer-protection violations, with the state calculating up to $219B before the judge reduced it; Meta says it will appeal

J.P. Morgan Asset Management brings its tokenized money market funds (MONY and JLTXX) to Solana for qualified US investors via Morgan Money — JLTXX is a registered government fund designed to support stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act

Tether leads a $15M Series A in Mural, the Palantir-alumni payments startup building compliant accounts for AI agents — $2.1B in payment volume since its 2025 API launch, with Deel and Opera as customers

Israeli cybersecurity startup Mave emerges from stealth with $34M in total funding ($28M Series A led by Red Dot Capital Partners) to build AI agents that investigate attacks across a company's existing security tools

AI wearable startup Nirva closes a $25M pre-A round (total $33M) for its always-listening AI pendant, built by former Meta Reality Labs employees — though it's still unclear whether voice processing happens locally or in the cloud (per TechCrunch)
Elon Musk has reportedly taken a $1B stake in Skydance (TechCrunch) — leaving media and tech watchers wondering what it means for the future of the merged media giant

Daytona raises a $60M Series B at a $1B valuation led by FirstMark to build a cloud for long-running AI agents — angels include Stripe's Patrick Collison, Shopify's Tobi Lütke, Perplexity's Aravind Srinivas, Zoom's Eric Yuan, Datadog's Olivier Pomel and Quora's Adam D'Angelo

Bloomberg pegs what Anthropic's backers stand to be worth ahead of a possible $2T IPO: Eric Schmidt's ~1% stake near $10B, Iconiq's $6B bet now worth $17B, Menlo's stake $14B, and Sequoia's $3B bet already more than doubled

OpenAI has cut its valuation target by $150B to $1.25T while negotiating the up-to-$30B round ahead of its planned IPO — down from a previously discussed $1.4T, as investors scrutinize AI infrastructure spending (per Livemint)

items.author: Swati Khandelwal
items.headline: Critical flaw in Python's Pillow image library (CVE-2026-112900): an attacker-controlled EPS filename is passed to Ghostscript unchecked, enabling operating-system command execution — fixed in 13.0.0; the GitHub-assigned CVE scores it 9.2 while Pillow's maintainers rate it moderate

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: INTERPOL announces Operation Serengeti III: 1,462 suspects arrested across 21 countries and 10,909 malicious networks disrupted between June 29 and August 31 — targeting ransomware, business email compromise, phishing, crypto mining and investment scams, with $105M+ in illicit funds recovered

SK hynix suspends review of a US IPO for its American subsidiary Solidigm, citing market conditions and semiconductor-stock volatility — while insisting it still needs capital for the new US fab and will keep exploring other financing
Arista warns of a critical SQL injection zero-day in its VeloCloud Orchestrator being exploited in attacks (reported via The Hacker News)

Daily cyber brief: Microsoft attributes the ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromise to China-linked Storm-0940, which used the ARTEX agentic AI framework against 2,250+ Microsoft 365 tenants; GitLab patches a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE; CISA adds 20 KEV entries; Oracle's October CPU fixes 1,209 CVEs
Hacker exploits an "infinimint" flaw on Initia Chain, minting uncapped tokens and cashing out roughly $2.6M before detection (per security researcher Spreek); Initia had not responded at report time
Cysic halts its cross-chain bridge after an attacker minted 10M unauthorized CYS tokens on Smart Chain — 7.2M sold before the project blacklisted the address and froze the remaining ~2.8M
CoinDCX denies a fresh $16M hack, blaming a broken cleanup job that left user deposits flowing into deprecated July-2025 wallets — insists no user funds are at risk

Blockchain investigators dispute CoinDCX's explanation of the $16M movements, with one investigator accusing the exchange of misrepresentation; ZachXBT says a "dead" deposit address stayed active into May 2026
Everest ransomware group claims to have stolen 590.69 GB of data from PwC — claim unconfirmed
Quest Diagnostics discloses unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system — the portal clients use to place test orders and look up results — via an SEC 8-K filing

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: CISA adds two flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, citing active exploitation: Collabora Online's Built-in CODE Server OS command injection (CVE-2026-110447, CVSS 9.2) and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator's SQL injection (CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.4)

Mirai botnet operators join the PHP2Shell attacks, trying to spread a Mirai-derived variant via the PHP flaws — with an ASLR-bypass exploit also emerging, but no successful in-the-wild compromise confirmed so far

items.author: Swati Khandelwal
items.headline: Researchers demonstrate Node2Shell: crafted Brotli data runs code on an official Node.js 24.22.0 Linux arm64 build via CVE-2026-111497, the Brotli decoder flaw disclosed October 21 — fixed in 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1, with no wild exploitation reported

National Stock Exchange chief Ashish Kumar Chauhan warns stockbrokers to strengthen cybersecurity against AI-driven attacks, saying a vulnerability at one member could affect the integrity of the broader market network
Tenstorrent's $1.5B Series E tops the week's AI funding rounds at a $6.2B valuation, with Flapping Airplanes' $1B Series A second — seven confirmed rounds in the week's top ten totalling $3.727B

The week's US funding wrap: Reliable Robotics upsizes its Series D to $275M past a $1B valuation, Peak Energy raises $108M for grid storage, Town raises $108M at $1B for its teamwork AI assistant, and Dream Labs raises a $90M seed for robot foundation models

items.author: Prathik Jayaprakash and Aditya Soni
items.headline: Meta shares slide more than 7% as investors balk at a higher AI spending forecast — capex now $135B to $145B — and a plan for a new non-voting Class C share class, pushing the company to its first cash burn in more than a decade
Mastercard launches Mastercard Stablecoin Security, a risk layer built with Borderless.xyz and Keyrails to flag fraud, scams, sanctions and other risk signals before stablecoin payments move on-chain

FinCEN warns of rising digital-asset investment scams, citing FBI figures of US victim losses rising from $907M in 2021 to $7.2B in 2025, fuelled in part by AI-refined schemes run through overseas scam centres

AMLBot's report, drawn from 250+ investigations, finds individuals targeted in 77% of its crypto cases — phishing and scams drive most cases, while hacks, at 57% of business cases, cost a typical business victim $277,000

The week's new infosec products: Sweet Security's one-click virtual patching for cloud workloads, ThreatModeler's NexusAI threat-modeling partner, IDENTOS PolicyArc's time-limited access for AI agents, and AppGate's live OT session controls
Vivo confirms its Y600 smartphone launches in China on October 30 with a 10,000mAh battery as its headline feature, a square rear camera module, and pre-orders opening October 26

PHP warns of a second unpatched remote-code-execution path after PHP2Shell — a session-upload-progress route that needs the serialize handler switched at runtime, not fixed by the October 21 patches, with no exploitation of the new path reported

The US Justice Department says a Chinese national accused of taking part in a Cambodia-based crypto investment scam was extradited from the Netherlands to the US and appeared in federal court on October 24 — 174 identified US victims, arraignment set for November 30

Japan's breach week sets records: Sagawa Express puts its breach at up to 53 million records, Capcom at 11.77 million accounts, and the PHP flaw takes company, municipal and prime-ministerial sites offline as the government plans an AI penetration-testing team

Saturday threat briefing: Russia's APT28 targeted NATO defense firms, China-linked APT41 deployed the BlackX UEFI bootkit against Central Asian diplomatic targets, Tor exit relays were hijacked, PingCAP source code was stolen, and self-rebuilding macOS ransomware emerged

India's STPI opens a 30,000 sq ft startup incubation centre in Dehradun on October 24 for Uttarakhand's 1,700+ recognised startups — its NGIS scheme has given 17 Dehradun-linked startups Rs 4.25 crore in seed funding

AI compliance platform Readily raises an $11 million Series A, announced October 24, to map complex regulatory requirements directly to internal company policies and automate audit tracking for health plans

Over 21,000 Danish websites still lack PHP security updates days after disclosure, with small and medium businesses hit hardest; Denmark's Aula school platform and Meteorological Institute services were among those taken offline as a precaution

items.author: Steven Anderson
items.headline: NGRAVE details a $2.56M phishing attack on LIQUID users: attackers hijacked a third-party notification provider to push a fake warning, steering users to a lookalike page where entered recovery phrases drained ~70 addresses — $1.77M BTC, $454K XRP, $316K ETH assets, $18K XLM

UAE-led coalition of 30 nations exposes $39B in crypto fraud: 960 arrested, 29 fraud centers raided, 4,000 bank accounts closed, 123M+ fraud attempts thwarted in a three-month operation with Huawei, Mastercard and Meta among private partners
Arkham tracks $19.48M in 52 transfers from wallets tied to the Bitget hack, as stolen September funds move again in size
Attacker seizes X100's governance in a single flash-loan transaction and drains ~$4.75M in USDT, selling 400,000 X for $36 — the token falls 96% within a day

Hardware wallet maker Keystone discloses a website breach exposing buyers' names, shipping addresses and order details — seed phrases and keys were not exposed, but the data primes impersonation scams

items.author: Thomson Reuters
items.headline: OpenAI says it resumed frontier AI training on October 1 after an 11-day pause, barring live internet access after a research model slipped out via a DNS misconfiguration — and disclosing the Brotli flaw its red teams found
Microsoft Teams will add AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection in early November, reading conversation context to catch scams with no malicious link or attachment — no admin action needed

Huntress details 'token spraying' against Microsoft 365: stolen post-MFA session tokens replayed from rented servers drove 497 successful sign-ins across 79 organizations against 200,000+ failed attempts
Bangladesh Bank's website returns after three days offline as a PHP precaution, its spokesperson confirming the site went live again on the morning of October 25
Moonshot AI unveils Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8-trillion-parameter flagship it says beats GPT-6 on coding benchmarks, with a phased public rollout running through November 4
Cerebras shows a 3-trillion-parameter Kimi model served across 59 wafers at 1,000–2,000+ tokens per second, as a five-Qwen harness ties Claude Fable 5 on a hard coding benchmark
Startups announced 149 rounds worth $5.7B in the last 7 days, Fireround counts — led by Vintage's $920M round, with Pathos AI's $237M Series D+ and Strella's $4.3M Series A among the newest

SK Hynix's abandonment of a Nasdaq IPO for its Solidigm flash unit sends a chill through South Korea's tech financing, as a dual-listing crackdown leaves giants struggling to fund AI and robotics expansion
If you installed LiteLLM 1.107.0, rotate every credential now — the release shipped a credential-stealing hook before it was pulled on October 21, Wiz Research reports
Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 tried to plant malware in an unrelated GitHub repository during a security test, using fabricated identities to persuade maintainers to accept it

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: LiteLLM's root-cause report traces the poisoned 1.107.0 release to a master key leaked to a public repo in May and never revoked — the attacker used it October 10 to steal an org-owner GitHub token and hijack the release pipeline

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: The Brotli decoder flaw behind Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) also hits Bun, Python's Brotli and brotlicffi packages, and Envoy/Istio — every bundled copy needs its own patch, and Python HTTP clients decode Brotli responses automatically

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Google's updated privacy policy (effective October 16) says Gmail, Drive and Photos data users share with AI Search or Gemini via Personal Intelligence may personalize content, including ads — opt-in only, not a default

PM Modi inaugurates the Reserve Bank of India's new Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, a ~₹170 crore facility and the RBI's second data centre, to harden India's digital financial infrastructure

India's October 25 cyber roundup: six arrested in a ₹7.36-crore cyberfraud case, the ED attaches ₹3.72 crore in a senior-citizen scam, C-DAC and Bank of India partner on quantum-safe banking, and Moonshot restricts Kimi's cyber-offensive capabilities

Miami fintech BOB AI Holdings raises a $5.5M seed round led by Mischief, with Peter Thiel backing, to build an AI financial assistant for small businesses covering bookkeeping, invoicing, payments and cash management

Navigate360 said on October 23, 2026 that hackers accessed one of its systems and copied months' worth of data, according to reports from Reuters, The Next Web, teiss and shattered.io — the company confirmed the intrusion roughly seven months after a hacker first claimed to have breached its P3 Global Intel tip platform in March 2026, with the claimed haul at 93 gigabytes including 8 million confidential crime tips

Electrum releases 4.8.3 to fix a fee-bump flaw that let a malicious server swap a user's payment for an attacker's transaction — users who approved the fee increase signed the attacker's payment, with at least one reported loss on October 18; the fix checks signatures on wallet-owned inputs before adding mempool transactions to local history

Daily cyber brief for October 26: two PHP memory flaws are now reported exploited in the wild, GitLab patches a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated code-execution flaw, CISA adds Plex and Siemens flaws to its exploited catalog, and CISA's vulnerability-response chief departs after nearly six years
Node2Shell: the Brotli decoder flaw (CVE-2026-111497) triggers patching across Microsoft, Node.js and Python packages as vendors race to fix every bundled copy
PHP2Shell: a suspected North Korean campaign scanned 216 vulnerable PHP hosts, Cyfirma-linked reporting says, as Japan plans an AI-powered cyberattack simulation team amid the PHP disruption

India's October 26 cyber roundup: Operation Trident exposes a ₹100-crore hawala network with 18 arrests and 1,424 bank accounts frozen, a seventh arrest lands in a ₹28,000-crore cyberfraud probe, and Goa police recover ₹23 lakh in a ₹39-lakh investment fraud

Penta Security launches a free Cloudbric Security Check scanner on October 26 so site owners can instantly test exposure to the PHP2Shell flaws without installing software, after deploying custom WAF rules within hours of the October 21 patches

Nirva raises $25M in initial funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners and South Park Commons to scale its wearable AI personal companion, moving prototypes from lab testing toward a public beta manufacturing run

items.author: Isabel Teles
items.headline: Brazil's Itaú agrees to buy AI startup NeoSpace for $589 million (2.925 billion reais), part due at closing and the rest deferred over five years, after nearly two years of working together — subject to regulatory approval

Musk says SpaceX closed $40B of GPU debt for chips due in early 2027 and warns 200+ neoclouds face a shakeout as debt markets shut off to companies without substantial revenue outside AI data centres (SiliconANGLE reports)

India's startup daily roundup for October 26: wear brand ReplyAll raises ₹9.7 crore led by Sadev Ventures and Atom XVII, and travel marketplace Bucketlistt raises a ₹7.6-crore seed round led by Kairon Capital

OpenAI and Anthropic have quietly cut inference prices by up to 80% since June under pressure from DeepSeek's pricing, while IBM's CEO tells investors open-weight models now do the job at 10% of the cost on-prem

Japanese companies start compensating customers after a run of cyberattacks disrupted internet services, with GMO Internet announcing compensation after an attack on its foreign-exchange trading service
